stats.noCostYet: No costs for {year} yet. Add a plan below or enter a price per visit for an activity.
stats.noPlansText: Add memberships, subscriptions and multi-visit cards, e.g. Urban Sports Club or your gym.
plan.name: Name
plan.hintAllocate: Without a provider or sport the costs are split across the assigned activities according to your visits.
plan.hintCancelled: Leave “Cancelled on” empty while the plan is running.
plan.hintCard: Each visit is booked proportionally: card price divided by the number of visits.
plan.addActivitiesFirst: Add activities first to assign them to this plan.
plan.hintVisits: Visits to these activities are attributed to the plan; this gives the cost per visit.
plan.errDateFirst: Enter the date of the first payment.
plan.errCancelBefore: The cancellation date is before the first payment.
plan.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.
visit.future: Visits can only be entered up to today.
visit.exists: A visit is already entered for this day.
toast.markedCancelled: Marked as cancelled, counts in no statistic
ed.name: Name
ed.descriptionPh: What it is about, what to expect
ed.photosHint: The first photo is the cover. Tap another photo to make it the cover.
ed.offerHint: For a course you only enter its length, training days and time. You are then planned for all sessions automatically.
ed.availHint: Overall period of the offer, e.g. an outdoor pool every year from May to September. Set different times per season above, per block, under “Applies”.
ed.courseNote: Course: you are planned for all sessions automatically. Remove single sessions in the detail view or mark them as “Cancelled”.
ed.signupNotesPh: e.g. book 48 hours ahead in the app
ed.memberLinkHint: The choice also links the activity to the plan, so visits and the cost per visit in the statistics are correct.
ed.noPlansHint: Add your memberships in the statistics under “Plans and memberships” to choose them here.
ed.priceHint: The price per visit feeds into the statistics. Leave empty if a plan covers the cost.
ed.plannedHint: Optional. Planned attendances appear in the calendar under “Planned”.
ed.plannedDaysHint: Only days on which the offer takes place according to your times are planned. Leave “Until” empty if it is open-ended.
ed.label: Label
ed.singlesHint: For dates that take place only once, e.g. a tournament.
ed.errRangeNeeds: Enter at least a from or until date for the period.
ed.errRangeOrder: In a period the until date is before the from date.
ed.courseNeedDates: Enter the course start and end.
ed.courseEndBefore: The course end is before the course start.
ed.courseNeedDay: Choose at least one training day.

ed.courseSummary.one: {n} session from {from} to {until}. You are planned for all of them.
ed.courseSummary.other: {n} sessions from {from} to {until}. You are planned for all of them.

ed.courseWeeksHint: The length sets the course end from the course start.
ed.coursePriceHint: The price is split across all sessions that take place; cancelled sessions do not count. A monthly fee applies to every month with course sessions, including part months, and is split across that month’s sessions. If a plan is linked to the course, the statistics count only the plan.
ed.errCoursePrice: Enter a valid course price, e.g. 120.00 or 1,200.
ed.errCourseLong: A course lasts 104 weeks at most.
ed.errCourseDay: Choose at least one training day for the course.
ed.splitToast: Split into summer and winter. Adjust the times in the winter block.
ed.photoFull: The photo storage is full. Remove some photos first.
ed.photoFailed: The photo could not be added.
ed.errVisitPrice: Enter a valid price per visit, e.g. 8.50.
ed.errUploading: Wait until all photos have been added.
ed.errEndBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
ed.errWeekday: Choose at least one weekday for regular attendance.
ed.errAvailRange: For the availability period the until date is before the from date.
ed.errPlanRange: For the planned attendance the until date is before the from date.
ed.errNoDates: Add at least one planned date or choose “Not planned”.
ed.addressUnchecked: The address could not be checked. Check it later under Map → Check addresses.
ed.planUpdateFailed: A plan could not be updated.
ed.errQuota: The storage is full. Delete an activity to add new ones.
ed.errLocalFull: The device storage for this page is full. Remove some photos.
ed.errSave: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.
